title: Low-degree junta Fourier family
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $k$ be a natural number. The low-degree junta Fourier family is the family of Fourier-coordinate sets produced in dimension equal to the number of coordinates outside $P$, using the low-degree cutoff at $k$.
caveat: The definitions of the low-degree cutoff and Fourier family are not included, so the exact membership criterion for this family cannot be stated.
